title: Supplement Planner
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Enter every supplemental essay prompt on your list, group them by type to see where one core essay can be adapted, and schedule the writing backward from deadlines.

learningObjectives: Students will plan their supplemental essays by organizing prompts by type, identifying where core material can be adapted, and scheduling each piece before its deadline.

controls: College input, type dropdown, word limit input, and deadline date input
Group view and Calendar view buttons
Remove selected, Priya's list, and Clear buttons

keyQuestions: Why can a community essay be adapted but a Why Us essay can't?
How does seeing every prompt in August change your fall?
Which pieces would you write first, and why?
commonMisconceptions: Supplements can be written in an evening each.
The same Why Us essay can be reused with a different college name.
assessmentOpportunities: Students produce a plan in which no week has more than three pieces and every core essay is scheduled before its adaptations.
